meta.what: walk-forward predictive stat-line distributions per fight-side (attacker = A or B) at the fight's ACTUAL length t, plus the unconditional mean (mixture over the methodround S fight-length distribution; backtest fights only)

sets.cv2020: 2020 fights, second stage trained on 2019 only (blend refit on 2019)
sets.raw2019: 2019 fights: p_dom only (from raw mlrates OOF rates; no earlier row to fit on)

meta.fields: per stat: nb -> [mu, k, uncond_mean]; zinb -> [mu, k, pi, uncond_mean]; zibeta (control seconds) -> [m, phi, pi, uncond_mean] with share s = y / (60 t) ~ Beta(m phi, (1 - m) phi) and P(0) = pi; NB2 variance mu + mu^2 / k; zinb P(0) = pi + (1 - pi) NB(0)
meta.p_dom: statlines winner expert P(A wins) = sigmoid(0.05 x (dominance A - dominance B)), dominance from expected unconditional totals with the engine's judging weights {"h_lnd": 1.0, "b_lnd": 0.8, "l_lnd": 0.55, "kd": 12.0, "td_lnd": 3.0, "ctrl": 0.06, "sub_att": 7.0}; 2019 rows from raw mlrates OOF rates (no second stage), 2020 y2020 fold
